full_judgment:
2. Short facts relevant for the disposal of this petition are that the land measuring an area of 15.10 acres in C.S. Khatian No. 233 of mouja Chalita Bonia under police station Morrelganj owned by two brothers namely, Sirajuddin and Daliluddin in equal shares. Sirajuddin died leaving two sons, the defendant Nos. 12 and 14 and Daliluddin died leaving four sons, the plaintiffs, the defendant No. 1 Abdul Majid and Abdul Aziz. Sirajuddin and Daliluddin decided to transfer the suit land by way of Hiba to their sons and at that time the plaintiffs were minors. As such the suit land was recorded in the names of two brothers Abdul Aziz and Abdur Rashid. Daliluddin and Sirajuddin executed two different deeds of Hiba on 11th June, 1973 and 30th June, 1973 and handed over the possession to their sons in respect of 15.20 acres. 0n the basis of those deeds, the defendant Nos 13 and 14 have been in possession of their shares. The plaintiffs were staying in different houses and possessed their shares. On 5th September, 1980 Anwar Hossain, the defendant No. 2 declared that S.A. record was not prepared in the plaintiffs name, which clouded their title in the suit land. 

 5. Mr. Abdul Wadud Bhuiyan, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners has taken us to the plaint and submits that the plaintiffs have sought for declaration of title of 3.80 acres out of 15.20 acres of land in respect of 4 khatians without giving any boundary of the suit land, and thus, apparently the suit land is vague but the High Court Division and this Division have totally ignored that aspect of the matter and maintained the decree. It is further contended that the suit is not maintainable without seeking relief for cancellation of the deeds of Hiba, inasmuch as, admittedly the plaintiffs father gifted his property to the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by two registered deeds of Hiba dated 10th June and 30th June, 1937 but the plaintiffs did not seek any relief for cancellation of the said registered instruments.
